name: Pennard Card Services

ring.prompt: Pennard Card Services. All calls are recorded. Please have the cardholder's details ready if you can. You are in a queue.

menu.prompt: To make a payment, press one. To report a bereavement, press two. To report a lost or stolen card, press three. For anything else, press four.
menu.wrongKeyPrompt: I'm sorry, that wasn't a valid selection. Please choose again.

holdAnnouncement: Please continue to hold. Your call will be answered in strict rotation.

clerk.greeting: Bereavement support, Geoffrey speaking. May I say how sorry I am for your loss. Could I take the cardholder's full name?

turns.reprompt: My apologies — the cardholder's full name again, with the surname spelt out if you would.

turns.say: Thank you. And the date of death?
turns.reprompt: Could you repeat that date for me, please?

turns.say: And am I speaking with a family member? Your name and relationship, please.
turns.reprompt: Just your name and your relationship to the cardholder, please.

documents: death certificate; the balance is frozen pending the estate
outcome.closing: The card is cancelled and the balance is frozen — no interest, no collections, and nothing for you to pay now. Your reference is {REF}. Our estates team will write to the executor directly.

quirk: Longest hold of the green set, but freezes interest and collections the moment the case opens.
